ItemDescription.Value: Calradia: Intergalactic — Void Traders, Starfleets & 3D Space Combat (CalradiaIntergalactic) — A sci-fi Total Conversion mod for Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord (v1.5.5+, Steam Deck & PC) fusing Starfield, No Man's Sky, Stellaris, Star Traders: Frontiers, and Warhammer 40k: Rogue Trader. Features: (1) Galactic Astrography grouping Towns as Star System Capitals/Starports, Castles as Orbital Starbases, and Bound Villages as Minor Colony Moons; (2) 3D Directional Zero-G Space Battles with 6-DOF look-vector flight thrusters, PEW-PEW 3D Plasma/Laser/Railgun bolts, WHHHAAAAM Photon Torpedo plasma shockwaves, recharging Void-Shields, and overhead 3D Capital Voidships exchanging orbital broadsides; (3) Modular Voidship Designer with 7 Hull Classes, S-Class Archeotech Drydock upgrades, Starfield Reactor Power Pip routing, and Star Traders Range-Band 5-to-1 ship combat; (4) Walkable 3D Flagship Bridge with a rotating 3D Holographic Starmap & Warp Reactor Core.

ChangeNotes.Value: v1.5.5.0 Initial Release: Complete Sci-Fi Total Conversion with Star System & Colony Moon astrography, 3D Zero-G directional space battles, PEW-PEW plasma bolts & WHHHAAAAM torpedo shockwaves, 7-hull Voidship Designer + Range-Band 5-to-1 combat, and Walkable 3D Flagship Bridge.
